expressions.cue: An archive groups the years 2010-2019 together. Write the decade label using 年代 and either an ordinary kanji whole number or plain Arabic digits. Read the year as a whole number, not digit by digit.
expressions.reading: にせんじゅうねんだい
readingAnswers: にせんじゅうねんだい
expressions.explanation: 二千十年代 names the 2010s in this context. 年代 makes a band of years; 二千十年 alone names the individual year 2010. A decade label does not tell how long one event lasted.
